methodology.description: Supplementary closed-trade risk metrics reported under separate entry-attribution and exit-realization conventions.
methodology.annualization: Trade-level Sharpe and Sortino annualized using realized trade frequency over calendar duration.
methodology.cvarConvention: Empirical mean of worst ceil(N × tail_probability) trade returns, minimum one trade.
methodology.criticalLimitation: Not a daily/4H mark-to-market portfolio equity curve. Do not use alone for final production-risk approval.

ENTRY_ATTRIBUTION.label: OOS Entry-Attributed Closed-Trade Metrics
ENTRY_ATTRIBUTION.inclusionRule: Include a closed trade if entryTime >= OOS_START_MS.
ENTRY_ATTRIBUTION.limitation: A trade may realize after its entry-attributed OOS window.

EXIT_REALIZATION.label: OOS Exit-Realized Closed-Trade Metrics
EXIT_REALIZATION.inclusionRule: Include a closed trade if exitTime >= OOS_START_MS.
EXIT_REALIZATION.limitation: A pre-OOS trade can contribute its full lifetime P&L if it exits during OOS.

methodology.inclusionRule: Include a closed trade if entryTime >= OOS_START_MS.
methodology.modeLimitation: A trade may realize after its entry-attributed OOS window.
methodology.equityBasis: Sequential compounding by closed trade, ordered by exit timestamp
methodology.annualization: Trade-level mean/std ratios annualized by observed trades per calendar year
methodology.primaryLimitation: This is supplementary trade-level risk analysis, not daily or 4H marked-to-market portfolio risk accounting.

riskAdjusted.cvar99Interpretation: Tail contains one trade; interpret as worst-trade diagnostic.
